recipe.visualDefinition: A theatrical stage scene featuring two caricatured men sitting on a bench with ventriloquist dummies, flanked by ornate gold mirrors displaying additional characters. The scene is framed by heavy purple curtains and a bright yellow spotlight, contained within a white border with horizontal pastel stripes and geometric accents.
coreVisualRelationships: Central caricatures anchored by a bright yellow circular spotlight
Symmetrical framing using purple curtains and gold-framed mirrors
Horizontal text bands at the top and bottom creating a structural sandwich
Triangular geometric markers pointing inward to the main titles
coreInvariants: White outer border with thin horizontal rule lines
Pastel pink and green color accents for geometric shapes
Caricature art style with heavy black outlines and watercolor-like shading

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central figures occupy the middle third; mirrors occupy the lower left and right thirds.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright yellow spotlight behind the central figures.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Top title down to the central spotlight, then out to the side mirrors, finishing at the bottom title.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Generous white margins at the top and bottom edges.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Pastel Pink and Mint Green (text and geometric shapes)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High-value pastels contrasted with saturated purple and yellow focal points.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Ampersand is simplified and matches the stroke weight of the letters
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used in different colors for top and bottom titles.
graphicDevices: Small equilateral triangles as bullet points

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric structure and circular counters.
Provides the necessary weight and modern-retro feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a cartoon illustration of two men in suits sitting on a bench with ventriloquist dummies on a stage. Include a bright yellow spotlight, purple curtains, and two ornate gold mirrors on the sides. Place this inside a white frame with horizontal pink and green lines.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add uppercase geometric sans-serif text in the top and bottom white margins. Use pastel pink for the top text and mint green for the bottom. Flank the text with small inward-pointing triangles.

verificationChecks: Spotlight creates a clear focal point

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the triangles point toward the text
Check that the horizontal lines are perfectly straight
Verify the caricature style is consistent across all figures
Confirm the white border is uniform
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a central caricature stage scene with a 'sandwich' layout of horizontal rules and wide-tracked geometric sans-serif display type in pastel tones.
